decision.reason: Standalone MMVQ is rejected for 10 tok/s, but top128 has a small positive SOTA-only bound (~4.46 tok/s before integration overhead). Because compare-only top1 passed while op-level error is nonzero, a logit-changing skip/write path must start with correctness-only top1 validation, not a strict cold SOTA benchmark.

implementation_boundary.default_path: must be unchanged when env is unset
implementation_boundary.first_verifier: llama-results fixed-text top1 with direct pool top128 and MMVQ skip enabled; require same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1, no OOM/no swap under 16GB cgroup
implementation_boundary.rollback: if top1 mismatches or strict cold does not beat 4.4 / violates TTFT/RAM/correctness, record rejected and do not promote; default-off source may be kept only if diagnostic infrastructure is useful and default path is proven unchanged
implementation_boundary.source_change: default-off only; add GGML_MOE_STREAM_MMVQ_HOT_BATCH_SKIP=1 plus report env, before CPU fallback; use direct hot pool resident src0 and F32 src1 rows; write dst and clear matrix_row_counts only on CUDA success.
implementation_boundary.strict_cold_benchmark: allowed only after top1 passes; strict France must beat 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, RAM/page-cache <= 16GB, correctness coherent

preferred_probe_shape.why: Top128 has the best projected net saving (~402 ms before scatter/scheduler) while keeping pool payload small enough to limit gate-cache penalty. Top64 has lower net; top256 has larger gate penalty.
